recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current build source already implements the Published Jira decision; any further canonical naming-style change should be handled by a new issue rather than this historical reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-17571 reported that VitalSigns-derived profiles such as BodyWeight reused the base VitalSigns name/title. It was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to address the tooling limitation by breaking the vital signs profile spreadsheet tabs into several spreadsheets, recorded as pre-applied.
initial_application: Historical commit be750bb59d92575730445cf25f9a2941fd04dd26, "preapply GF#17571 fix titles in vitals panel", split the Observation vital signs profile tabs into separate spreadsheet files and registered specific entries for Body Weight, Body Height, Heart Rate, Respiratory Rate, Oxygen Saturation, BMI, Blood Pressure, Head Circumference, Body Temperature, and Vital Signs Panel profiles.
additional_context: Observation is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/observation/implementationguide-Observation-vitalsigns.xml references StructureDefinition/bodyweight and its sibling profiles. Later source conversion and metadata cleanup preserved distinct profile-specific metadata in current StructureDefinition XML. Zulip discussion corroborated the reporter's concern and the expectation that derived profiles have specific names/titles; Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-bodyweight.xml has name Observationbodyweight and title Observation Body Weight Profile, while the base profile remains Observationvitalsignsbase / Vital Signs Base Profile. Exact current-source searches found no remaining old offending metadata such as <name value="Vital Signs Profile"> or <title value="VitalSigns">.

related_jiras.note: Later canonical resource name/title cleanup touched the current StructureDefinition XML family, but this reconciliation only audited FHIR-17571.
